items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I just did an overdub [on the record with Nils Petter Molvaer]

ctx.x: different way to play, because nobody plays rubato like them. They are rubato experts. That’s what they do.
Here’s – I’m looking at one record you did with Lars with the now very popular Nils Petter Molvaer on trumpet.
Yeah, but I think that’s his production record. I just did an overdub.
